articles_fetched.summary: Pace layers: products iterate fast, the system is slow stable infrastructure; 'fast learns, slow remembers'; teams build recipes when the system lacks something.
Five layers: core (tokens, icons, components, reference site), optional tech-specific, recipe and smart layers, then products; start simple, add layers only when needed.
